learning_outcomes.text: Explain health-and-safety management principles and the duty of care
Identify hazards and assess risk using a structured method
Apply the hierarchy of controls to reduce risk
Describe the elements of a health-and-safety management system
Investigate incidents and drive corrective and preventive action

integrative_case: A newly appointed safety coordinator at a warehouse must raise the site's safety performance: run a risk assessment of a manual-handling task, apply the hierarchy of controls, outline the management system elements needed, and present an incident-investigation finding with preventive actions to the site manager.
